privacy_redaction.hardware_identity: Public copy: physical GPU model and UUID are withheld; architecture labels do not identify a particular supported profile.
privacy_redaction.provenance: Measurements are retained. Embedded signatures, source digests and byte counts describe the private original records unless explicitly labeled as public-copy digests.
privacy_redaction.usage: Redacted review material, not an unmodified calibration input or a hardware identity attestation.

archive_transformations: Local checkpoint and validation-root paths replaced with display placeholders.
Only batch-accounting evidence retained; original reports and logs stay in the local validation directory.

fixture.generation: For i=0..12: instruction="What is {i} + 2? Explain.", input="Use whole numbers.", output=("Adding {i} and 2 gives {i+2}. " repeated 1+2*i times).strip(); JSONL records use sorted keys.
fixture.runtime_cache_state: Existing shared framework/kernel caches; no controlled cold/warm cache claim.

limitations: Padding budgets every output sequence to sequence_length; dynamic batch padding, shuffling and distributed sampling are not modeled.
No filtering, train/validation splitting, resampling or framework preprocessing is performed.
The exact count describes the supplied processed rows; source-framework execution and training-split provenance are not verified.
input_ids are used as supplied; their original tokenizer and template cannot be inferred.
Supervised tokens count nonignored labels at nonpadding positions before any causal loss shift.

validation.independent_audit: Passed: frozen sources, distinct successful processes, actual Arrow row hashes/counts, per-epoch consumed row accounting, update timing, window grouping, and all saved adapter values.

limitations: One native run per framework verifies batch observation and bookkeeping, not timing prediction accuracy.
Every measured accumulation-window group lacks a second steady sample; all sufficient flags are false.
Axolotl includes long measured updates after the excluded first update; these remain recorded and are not certified steady kernel timings.
Position IDs were not exposed in these native training_step inputs; position-reset coverage is zero.
Native packing and dynamic-shape extrapolation remain unsupported.
Allocator peaks are global to each run and are not attributed to individual shapes.
